versions.name: Super Dash Menu
versions.description: A mod that adds a menu similar to that of Mario Maker 2!

about:
# Super Dash Menu

If you've ever played Mario Maker 2, you might find the UI to be a lot different to one like Geometry Dash.
This mod changes Geometry Dash's menu to be like Mario Maker 2!

This is probably the closest they'll be to eachother because if I changed Mario Maker's menu to be like Geometry Dash, Nintendo would not be very happy with me, would they?

Alongside UI modifications, this mod also adds a new challenge to the game - Endless Mode! See how many levels you can complete!

Thanks to my friend CasualAnimGD for helping with the coding!
changelog:

# 1.0.1
- Made it so that instead of fully deleting menu nodes, it instead makes them invisible. Turns out that's frowned upon.

# 1.0.0
- Added the mod. This includes the main menu modifications, Endless Mode, and all the other stuff.
